about: The features of a project as the marshal records them: one row each, or one row for the feature named. `lease` and `minutes_since_renewal` mean what `lease_clock` says. wall (local records): the wall clock, whole minutes since `renewed_at`; a record without a readable `renewed_at` reads as stale. observed-here (shared refs records): how long this machine saw the record's commit unchanged on its own monotonic clock; a first read on a machine reports 0 minutes, a missing age reads as live, and two hosts can give different answers for one record. `remote` says whether the answer was checked against the remote of the shared records: none (the local backend has no remote), checked (the fetch ran and worked), unchecked (the fetch was tried and failed, the answer is from the cache this machine fetched last), not-asked (nothing was fetched: --no-fetch, --no-write or a member run; on the local backend `remote` is none whatever the options). A reader that builds on the answer must read `remote`. `rev` is the revision of the record, not a lease revision. The values of a local record are shown as the record holds them: a record that holds a value the shape does not allow makes the verb exit 70 and print no document. `integrity` is the integrity setting of the project, off, advisory or strict: with off the records are unsigned by design and no row has the fields `integrity`, `integrity_note` and `signer`; with advisory or strict every row has them.
writes: Unless --no-write is given: on the local backend a record whose branch is gone is marked abandoned; on the shared refs backend the call fetches the shared records into this machine's cache and updates this machine's own observation cache, with --no-fetch too (a lock file with it) and, with integrity on, its acceptance marks. With --no-write nothing is written and nothing is fetched. The shared records are never changed.

integrity.description: The integrity setting of the project (qargi marshal enable --integrity): off, so the records are unsigned by design and a row has no `integrity`, `integrity_note` or `signer`; advisory or strict, so a row says whether its record is signed and by whom (a row of an unsigned record says so). Read it before you read a signature field that is missing.

backend.description: Where the records live: this host's files or the shared refs of the project's remote.

remote.description: Whether the answer was checked against the remote of the shared records: none, checked, unchecked (the fetch failed) or not-asked (--no-fetch, --no-write or a member run).

features.description: One row for each open feature, a feature with a branch or a record that is neither finished nor abandoned (with --history the finished and abandoned ones follow; with NAME the one named).

agent_unattributed.description: The agent branches of no open feature that are merged neither into develop nor into a feature branch; said once, not under each feature. Always empty with --brief.

worktree.x-when: The lead record names its work tree (a digest of its path).

succeeds.x-when: The lead took over as the successor of an earlier lead of the same host, user and work tree.

base.description: The branch the run was prepared against; empty when none is recorded.

directory_gone.description: The run directory no longer exists.

state.description: A sentence made of the booleans above, such as: verified, applied, directory gone.

status.description: unled: the feature has a branch and no record.

lease.description: none: the feature has no lead.

minutes_since_renewal.description: Whole minutes; null when the feature has no lead or the age is unknown.

renewed_at.description: The time of the last renewal as the record holds it; null when it was never renewed.

branch.description: The branch feature/NAME exists in this repository.

ghost.description: The record is abandoned and its branch is gone.

provisional.x-when: Shared refs backend: true while a claim has not reached the remote.

integrity.x-when: The project's integrity setting is not off.

integrity_note.x-when: The project's integrity setting is not off.

signer.x-when: The project's integrity setting is not off; empty when the record is not signed.

tasks.x-when: Present for every row of marshal status.

agent_branches.x-when: Present for every row of marshal status: the agent branches prepared against the feature and not merged into it.

worktrees.x-when: Present for every row of marshal status.

overlap.x-when: Present for every row of marshal status: the other open features that change the same files, with the files.

history.change: the top-level `integrity` (off, advisory or strict) is required: it says whether an unsigned record is unsigned by design
